sentence: Never leave Jormama off the stench she built the story on.

wombos.definition: John Pork's baby mama — a figure defined entirely by her relationship to John Pork, shrouded in the same mysterious, enigmatic energy.
wombos.example: Nobody talks about Jormama enough — she's just as mysterious as he is.

wombos.definition: A bench that serves as the setting for delivering a story or piece of content — a storytelling bench.
wombos.example: He sat down on the stench and launched into the most unhinged peanemis of the year.
